Beau, saw Chili's came back to Ziosk for pay-at-table across more than 1,100 locations.

I built a signal play for Ziosk off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
